answer: Agents deter Sybil attacks using hydrodynamic acoustic profiling along coastal waterways. A candidate vessel traverses a hollow conduit while emitting sonar pulses toward benthic hydrophones during its voyage. Adversaries cannot virtualize nodes because authentic acoustic displacement requires dedicated submersible hulls and physical transducers per identity.
